proposed_widenings.name: block_healing
proposed_widenings.justification: Chill Touch applies a timed rider on hit that prevents the target from regaining Hit Points until the end of the caster's next turn. The current Effect type only supports damage | none; v4 has no atom for suppressing or blocking HP recovery. The rider is mechanically deterministic (it fires on every hit, lasts until a fixed turn boundary) and is a primary defining mechanic of the spell — not a narrative side-effect. A new atom is needed to represent this pattern, which also appears in other necromancy effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, and it can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

notes: The activation family, attack_roll phase, melee_spell_attack, and threshold_tiers cantrip scaling all fit cleanly. The chill_touch.dhall encodes the damage portion honestly. The 'can't regain HP' rider is intentionally omitted from the Dhall because Effect = damage | none and no block_healing atom exists in v4. The trace is complete for what it encodes and the omission is documented here and in proposal-chill_touch.md.
